parole.significato: a Black person, a person from Africa and/or with sub-Saharan origin.
parole.testo: Ultimately from Arabic مُحَمَّد (muḥammad), via North and West African languages such as Hausa Muhammadu. Doublet of Mahomet and Mohammed. (1897) The noun comes from the given name. It was first used in a catholic faith report to describe derogatorily an undetermined African person.
